metric_legend.required_unit_growth_pct: (current partial contribution / candidate partial contribution - 1) * 100, only if both positive. A negative value is tolerable unit decline; it is not forecast demand.
metric_legend.contribution_rub: Partial contribution under supplied procurement, tariffs, observed-service and tax assumptions; unknown costs remain explicitly unverified.

finance_period.interpretation: Observed accruals only; unavailable dates are not zero-sales dates.

limitations: Every amount is partial contribution, not verified net profit.
No universal percentage reserve, packaging charge or minimum profit is invented.
Action-specific fees and simultaneous promotion effects require verification.
Price indexes are observations, not independent competitor research.
No sales-volume uplift is forecast and no price is approved.
